# The Notepad++ application bundle: upstream's objects, the runtime, Scintilla and Lexilla.

# --- COM interface identifiers (Wine's uuid library, generated by widl) ------------------------
file(GLOB nppUuidSources "${NPPMAC_WINE_UUID_DIR}/*_i.c")
add_library(nppUuid STATIC ${nppUuidSources})
target_link_libraries(nppUuid PRIVATE nppRuntimeHeaders)
target_compile_options(nppUuid PRIVATE -w)

# --- Stubs for Win32 functions not implemented yet -----------------------------------------------
set(nppSystemLibraries "-framework Cocoa" "-framework QuartzCore" "-framework CoreText" "-framework Security" "-framework UniformTypeIdentifiers")
# The probe also gets what the runtime links itself (iconv).
string(REPLACE ";" "|" nppSystemLibrariesArgument "-lc++;-liconv;${nppSystemLibraries}") # a list cannot pass through -D
string(REPLACE " " "|" nppSystemLibrariesArgument "${nppSystemLibrariesArgument}")
set(stubInputs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stub-inputs.txt")
set(stubProviders "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stub-providers.txt")
set(stubSource "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/RuntimeStubs.c")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${stubInputs}" CONTENT
	"$<JOIN:$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream>,\n>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppRuntime>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppScintilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppLexilla>\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${stubProviders}" CONTENT
	"$<JOIN:$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream>,\n>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppRuntime>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppScintilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppLexilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppUuid>\n")

add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT "${stubSource}"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -DNM=${CMAKE_NM} -DCC=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} "-DLINK_LIBRARIES=${nppSystemLibrariesArgument}"
		-DINPUTS_FILE=${stubInputs} -DPROVIDERS_FILE=${stubProviders} -DOUTPUT=${stubSource}
		-P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/stubs/GenerateStubs.cmake"
	DEPENDS nppUpstream nppRuntime nppScintilla nppLexilla nppUuid
		$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream> "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/stubs/GenerateStubs.cmake"
	COMMENT "Generating stubs for Win32 functions the runtime does not implement yet"
	VERBATIM
)
add_library(nppRuntimeStubs STATIC "${stubSource}")
target_compile_options(nppRuntimeStubs PRIVATE -w)

# --- Application -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(nppResources "")
macro(nppAddResources destination)
	foreach(resourceFile ${ARGN})
		set_source_files_properties("${resourceFile}" PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "Resources/${destination}")
		list(APPEND nppResources "${resourceFile}")
	endforeach()
endmacro()

set(nppInstaller "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/installer")
file(GLOB nppLocalization CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/nativeLang/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppAutoCompletion CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/APIs/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppFunctionList CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/functionList/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppThemes CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/themes/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppUserDefineLangs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/userDefineLangs/markdown._preinstalled*.udl.xml")
file(GLOB scintillaResources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${NPP_ROOT}/scintilla/cocoa/res/*.png")

# Laid out as upstream's packageAll.bat lays out the Windows zip; Contents/Resources is the
# program directory Notepad++ sees (GetModuleFileNameW points there).
nppAddResources("" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/langs.model.xml" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/stylers.model.xml"
	"${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/tabContextMenu_example.xml" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/toolbarButtonsConf_example.xml"
	"${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/readme.txt" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/change.log"
	"${nppInstaller}/xml4Config/disableNppAutoUpdate.xml" ${scintillaResources})
nppAddResources("localization" ${nppLocalization})
nppAddResources("autoCompletion" ${nppAutoCompletion})
nppAddResources("functionList" ${nppFunctionList})
nppAddResources("themes" ${nppThemes})
nppAddResources("userDefineLangs" ${nppUserDefineLangs})

# The app icon, made from NPPMAC_APP_ICON.
set(appIcon "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/AppIcon.icns")
add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT "${appIcon}"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make-icns.sh" "${NPPMAC_APP_ICON}" "${appIcon}"
	DEPENDS "${NPPMAC_APP_ICON}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make-icns.sh"
	COMMENT "Making the app icon"
	VERBATIM
)
set_source_files_properties("${appIcon}" PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)

add_executable(NotepadPlusPlus MACOSX_BUNDLE main.cpp $<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream> ${nppResources} "${appIcon}")
set_target_properties(NotepadPlusPlus PROPERTIES
	OUTPUT_NAME "${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Info.plist.in"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "${NPPMAC_BUNDLE_ID}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE "AppIcon.icns"
)
target_compile_definitions(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE "NPPMAC_APP_NAME=\"${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}\"")
target_include_directories(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_SRC}")
# The whole runtime goes in, not only what Notepad++ itself calls: plugins bind to the Win32 functions
# they use in the app (see macos/plugins).
target_link_libraries(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE
	"$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,nppRuntime>" nppRuntimeHeaders nppRuntimeStubs nppUuid nppScintilla nppLexilla
	${nppSystemLibraries}
)

# --- Resources ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream's .rc files (rcFiles in PowerEditor/src/CMakeLists.txt), compiled with llvm-rc from the
# original sources, in upstream's directory and with upstream's include list, as on Windows. The
# .res files go into Contents/Resources/res, where the runtime's resource loader reads them.
find_program(NPPMAC_LLVM_RC llvm-rc HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin /usr/local/opt/llvm/bin REQUIRED)
string(REGEX MATCH "SET\\(rcFiles([^)]*)\\)" nppRcMatch "${nppUpstreamCMake}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t\r\n]+" ";" nppRcFiles "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
list(FILTER nppRcFiles INCLUDE REGEX "\\.rc$")
string(REGEX MATCH "SET\\(projIncludDir([^)]*)\\)" nppRcIncludeMatch "${nppUpstreamCMake}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t\r\n]+" ";" nppRcIncludes "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
set(nppRcFlags "")
foreach(includeDir IN LISTS nppRcIncludes)
	if(NOT includeDir STREQUAL "")
		list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${includeDir}")
	endif()
endforeach()
list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/include")
foreach(wineDir IN LISTS NPPMAC_WINE_INCLUDE_DIRS)
	list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${wineDir}")
endforeach()

set(nppResFiles "")
foreach(rcFile IN LISTS nppRcFiles)
	string(REGEX REPLACE "^\\./" "" rcRelative "${rcFile}")
	get_filename_component(rcName "${rcRelative}" NAME_WE)
	set(resFile "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/res/${rcName}.res")
	get_filename_component(rcDirectory "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}/${rcRelative}" DIRECTORY)
	file(GLOB rcDependencies "${rcDirectory}/*.h" "${rcDirectory}/*.rc")
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT "${resFile}"
		COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/res"
		COMMAND "${NPPMAC_LLVM_RC}" ${nppRcFlags} -c 65001 -D_WIN64 -DUNICODE -D_UNICODE -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0601 -DNTDDI_VERSION=0x06010000
			-fo "${resFile}" "${rcRelative}"
		WORKING_DIRECTORY "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}"
		DEPENDS "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}/${rcRelative}" ${rcDependencies}
		COMMENT "Compiling resources ${rcRelative}"
		VERBATIM
	)
	set_source_files_properties("${resFile}" PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "Resources/res")
	list(APPEND nppResFiles "${resFile}")
endforeach()
target_sources(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE ${nppResFiles})

# --- Tests -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The end-to-end smoke test needs a window server (a logged-in macOS session); its label lets it be
# left out with ctest -LE gui.
add_test(NAME nppSmokeTest COMMAND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../ci/smoke-test.sh" "$<TARGET_FILE:NotepadPlusPlus>" "$<TARGET_FILE:HelloMac>")
set_tests_properties(nppSmokeTest PROPERTIES LABELS gui TIMEOUT 600)
